phoneme_focus: Intonation of complaint vs wish; 'wish' /wɪʃ/ + weak forms

grammar_point.title: wish / if only (regrets & wishes)
grammar_point.en: Wishes/regrets about the present (wish + past) and past (wish + past perfect); wish + would for complaints.
grammar_point.ar: الأمنيات والندم عن الحاضر (wish + ماضٍ) والماضي (wish + past perfect)؛ wish + would للشكوى.

Saturday.prompt: Say three wishes about your present life ('I wish I had/were/could...').

Sunday.prompt: Say three regrets about the past ('I wish I had...').

Monday.prompt: Make three polite complaints with 'I wish ... would ...'.

Tuesday.prompt: Use 'if only' for two strong wishes and one regret.

Wednesday.prompt: Complain politely about a service, then suggest an improvement.

Thursday.prompt: Share wishes/complaints with a partner and respond sympathetically.

Friday.prompt: Talk about your wishes, regrets and pet peeves (9-10 sentences) using wish/if only.

writing_prompts: Write three wishes about your present ('I wish I had/were/could...').
Write three regrets about the past ('I wish I had...').
Write three complaints with 'I wish ... would ...'.
Use 'if only' for two wishes and one regret.
Write a polite complaint email about a poor service.
Answer: What do you wish were different about your daily life?
Write a paragraph mixing present wishes, past regrets and complaints.
